description: Balance and activity of a Bitcoin address: confirmed/unconfirmed balance, UTXO count and total, tx count, last 10 transactions. Supports P2PKH (1…), P2SH (3…), bech32 (bc1q…), bech32m (bc1p…). When to use: how much BTC this address holds, whether it received funds, how active it is. Note: ultra-active addresses such as exchange cold wallets may return a degraded response under index load.
name: btc_address_summary
